text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm here to soothe this burning passion,
and to
satiate this aching thirst.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your help.
...All I ask is that
you don't
get in my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
